tool_input.command: cd node_modules/@guren/core/dist; grep -rln "Accept-Language\|accept-language" . | head; grep -rn "cookie" $(grep -rl "accept-language" . | head -3) | head -40
tool_input.description: Find locale detection code in core

result:
The blog now runs in English and Japanese, with a language switcher in the site header. `bun run typecheck`, `bun test` (9 tests, 0 failures) and the full `bunx guren gate` all pass. The catalog check reports both `lang/en` and `lang/ja` covering all 29 keys. I didn't boot the app or try the switcher in a browser. The new tests drive it in-process.

- **Detection:** The framework's built-in detection already reads a `locale` cookie before `Accept-Language`, so turning on `ja` in `src/app.ts` gives Japanese to a Japanese browser on a first visit. A reader's saved choice beats the browser setting.
- **`POST /locale`:** It checks `{ locale }` the same way the post form checks its fields, so `fr` or a missing field gets the same 422 as an invalid post title and no cookie is set. A valid pick stores a `locale` cookie for one year and redirects back to the `Referer`. If the Referer is missing or points at another site, it redirects to `/` instead.
- **Header:** The English "Write" link now reads "New post" (新規投稿), because the spec ties that link to `posts.new`. I also added a Home link next to the site name, and the Japanese "Sign in" link reads ログイン. The switcher has English and 日本語 buttons, visible to guests and signed-in users.
- **Posts pages:** The list, post page, and new/edit forms take all their labels from the catalogs. The search result count uses a plural form, and no source file under `resources/` or `app/` contains 「記事」.
- **Not translated:** Home, login, register, dashboard and profile pages are still English only. The request only covered the header and the posts pages. Validation error messages such as "Title is required." are also still English only.

In summary, I added Japanese catalogs under `lang/ja/` (`messages`, `nav`, `auth`, `posts`, `locales`), each matching a new or existing English file in `lang/en/`. On the server, `app/Http/Validators/LocaleValidator.ts` defines the supported locales and the rule for `/locale`, `app/Http/Controllers/LocaleController.ts` sets the cookie and redirects, and `routes/web.ts` registers the route. `src/app.ts` now supports `['en', 'ja']`. On the front end, `resources/js/components/Layout.tsx` has the switcher and translated header links, and the four `resources/js/pages/posts/*.tsx` pages use translated labels. Codegen refreshed the `.guren/*.gen.ts` files, and `tests/LocaleController.test.ts` covers the default, the browser setting, the cookie winning over it, the redirect cases and rejected values.
